(lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 2)) (range (rows g)))) (range (cols g))))) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((r (in-list rs))) (paint-cells out (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) cs) 3)))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (direction value)
      (cond
        ((= value 4) (list -1 0))
        ((= value 5) (list 0 1))
        ((= value 6) (list 1 0))
        ((= value 7) (list 0 -1))
        (else (list 0 0))))
    (define (walk-ray start)
      (let* ((r (first start))
             (c (second start))
             (delta (direction (at g r c)))
             (dr (first delta))
             (dc (second delta)))
        (if (and (= dr 0) (= dc 0))
            (list)
            (let loop ((rr r) (cc c) (acc (list)))
              (let ((nr (+ rr dr)) (nc (+ cc dc)))
                (if (or (not (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g)))
                        (= (at g nr nc) 8))
                    (reverse (cons (list rr cc) acc))
                    (loop nr nc (cons (list rr cc) acc))))))))
    (let* ((rs (filter (lambda (r) (member? 1 (list-ref g r)))
                       (range (rows g))))
           (cs (filter (lambda (c)
                         (any? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 2))
                               (range (rows g))))
                       (range (cols g))))
           (route-starts
             (flatmap (lambda (r)
                        (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) cs))
                      rs))
           (route-cells
             (remove-duplicates (flatmap walk-ray route-starts))))
      (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) route-cells 3))))
